definitions: To shout or speak loudly to attract attention or to summon someone.
To give a name or title to someone or something.
To make a telephone call to someone.
To arrange for a meeting or event to take place.
To describe or label someone or something in a particular way.
examples: She had to call his name several times.
They decided to call the baby Sarah.
I'll call you later this evening.
The manager will call a meeting for next week.
Some people call him a genius.
